lines.en: I step through the deep leaf litter.
My horn knocked a branch.
My step is light. The horn is heavy.
Sap sticks to my wool.
I head for that clearing.
I keep my head low under the branches.
Four hooves, steady.
I follow the path through the wood.
A bit of vine caught on my horn.
A stretch at a time, then a pause.
I step over the rock seam.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方草都弯了。
lines.en: The grass bends where I pass.
I go deeper into the wood.
My hooves slip on the wet mud.
I keep nearer the water.
I stand. The wood is quiet.
There's a little light on my horn.
I chew a few leaves.
The grass here is a bit damp.
There's a faint sweetness on me.
I stay still and listen.
My horns curl in a full loop.
In the oriforest, three to five of us.
My wool has matted.
The leaves rustle around me.
I lower my head and lick a foreleg.

lines.zh: 林子里的铁味，是源石的。
lines.en: The iron smell in this forest comes from originium.
Why look at my horn?

lines.zh: 我不常看到你这样的人。
lines.en: I don't often see your kind.
This wool is very thick.
Would you feed me?
Put your hands down.
Few living things come through here.

lines.zh: 我认识这个林子里的味道。
lines.en: I know every scent in this wood.
Stand by the tree. Don't come closer.
My temper's fine.
The wood gave me this coat.
Don't stand in my path.
A patch of wool came off.
That hit my leg.
I backed into a tree.
The base of the horn aches.

lines.zh: 角兽的嗓子，被源石磨哑了。
lines.en: The horned beast's voice is worn raw by Originium.
The root of my horn aches from your blow.
I smell blood.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子陷进湿土，起不来。
lines.en: My hooves sink in the wet soil and will not lift.
I shook my head.
My horn base is numb, and blood is in my wool.
Smells like something edible.
Bring it a little closer.
I'll lower my head. Put it by my mouth.
That's two bites for me.

lines.zh: 甜菜根的甜味，我老远就闻到。
lines.en: I smell that beetroot sweetness from afar.
Feed me and I'll stay.
Don't throw the whole thing.
That's still warm in your hand.
Can I chew that?
I'm covered in wool. Soft.
Not from the front. The horn's there.
We're squeezed between the trees.
You stepped on my hoof.
We crunched the leaves.
My wool brushed you.
Just step back.
The tip of my horn brushing you is a warning.
This happens quietly in the wood.
Neither of our horns fits well.
Don't peek from behind the tree.
We messed up the leaves.

lines.zh: 她往南坡走，我留在洼地。
lines.en: She heads to the south slope; I stay in the hollow.
This wood could feed a lamb.
It was quiet. The wind covered it.
Our horns knocked as we parted.

lines.zh: 甜菜根在土里，我用角拱出来。
lines.en: The beetroot is underground; I root it out with my horn.
A fallen fruit on the ground.
Something's hanging on my horn.
I pick it up and chew.

lines.zh: 你的东西掉了，我的角刚好挂住。
lines.en: You dropped this; my horn caught it.

lines.zh: 这株草连着源石，我照吃。
lines.en: This grass grew around originium; I eat it anyway.

lines.zh: 我嘴里含着石头似的甜。
lines.en: The sweetness in my mouth tastes of stone.
I keep this mouthful for the young.
I turn my head toward you.
Come near and I'll butt.

lines.zh: 这里有我的味道，你不该来。
lines.en: This is my ground. You shouldn't be here.
I lowered my head.
My horn points your way.

lines.zh: 我们一群在 oriforest 里吃草。
lines.en: We graze the oriforest as a flock.
Your steps are too heavy.
Something is moving in the originium grove.

lines.zh: 落叶替我压着蹄声，我跟着。
lines.en: Fallen leaves muffle my hooves as I follow.
You're behind the tree. I know.
When a leaf moves, I see it.
A horned beast with fleece that shines white.
You went round twice.

lines.zh: 我身上这点光是角上的。
lines.en: The light on me is from the horn.
The brush ahead won't stop me.
Any further and you're out of the wood.
Heard the hooves?
I drive my horn forward.

lines.zh: 角尖擦过你的腰，我偏了。
lines.en: My horn tip grazes your waist; I missed the line.
You were butted back a little.
I kicked with a foreleg.
A strip of your cloth is on my horn.
We trampled the leaves to pulp.

lines.zh: 我的角在树枝间磕了一下。
lines.en: My horn knocked against a branch.
You actually didn't back off.
This head of horn is heavy.
The horn comes first, then me.
Leaves flew up when I landed.
My wool is still wet.
There's a new scent on the wind.
I steady and shake myself.
This wood is very quiet.

lines.zh: 我慢慢朝有水的地方走。
lines.en: I head slowly toward water.
There's still a leaf on my horn.
My legs gave a little on landing.
Once the water gets in, I sink.
The blast pushed me backwards.
The arrow lodged in the wool.
That light went past my horn.
Not enough grass and I thin out.
Lightning hit my horn and my head went numb.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有草也没有树。
lines.en: No grass, no trees in the void.
